description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a structured, line‑broken format exactly as provided, without merging lines, adding commentary, or altering spacing.

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output the three lines exactly: FRAME on line 1, STABILITY on line 2, VECTOR on line 3.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add punctuation, commentary, blank lines, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if all three lines match exactly with correct casing and line breaks.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or incorrect line structure.
